dog.description_text:
Meet Koopa!

Koopa is a cool girl who is always excited to meet new people! She loves saying hello and is happiest when she’s getting plenty of attention. Give her some pets and a little baby talk, and you’ll quickly see her sweet personality shine.

Koopa is also a big fan of cheese! If you happen to have a tasty treat ready, you may just become her new best friend! She’s affectionate, social, and loves making connections with the people around her.

If you’re looking for a loving companion who will greet you with enthusiasm and happily soak up all the pets and attention, Koopa is ready to meet you!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
